title: Chats over several library papers
acceptance_criteria: Given any chat, at any time, when the user types @ in the chat composer, then the same paper picker as on the home page lets them add library papers (up to five ready papers) or remove included ones; the included papers show as removable chips at the top of the chat.
Given the paper whose id is in the chat's URL is removed, when the chat updates, then it re-routes to /papers/{new first paper}/chats/{chatId}; the last remaining paper cannot be removed.
Given a chat with several papers, when any of those papers is opened, then the chat appears in its chat list.
Given a question over several papers, when evidence is retrieved, then every included paper gets a fair share of the context and comparisons cite each relevant paper.
Given a citation to a document outside the chat's papers, when the answer is validated, then it fails as today.
Given a paper removed from a chat, when history is viewed, then earlier answers keep their citations, and the chat no longer appears under that paper.
Given existing single-paper chats, when the migration runs, then each becomes a one-paper chat with its pinned PDF and unchanged history.

Given a comparative question over several papers, when the planner runs, then it produces per-paper sub-questions, retrieves each within its paper's documents, and synthesizes one answer that cites each paper.
Given the papers in a chat, when retrieval runs, then all of them use the same embedding model, so one filtered vector search spans them.

Given EXPERIMENTAL_OPEN_MODELS is off, when multi-paper chats are used, then only hosted models apply; with the flag on, multi-paper chats are unavailable to local models while open models stay frozen.
Given an answer citing several papers, when it renders, then each citation names its paper and page.

Given a citation to a paper other than the one in the reader, when it is clicked, then the reader opens that paper's PDF in a new tab (or focuses its existing tab) at the cited passage; the user can switch between tabs and close any tab except the last.
Given a multi-paper chat, when it is opened or linked from any of its papers, then its URL is /papers/{first paper in the chat's list}/chats/{chatId}.
test_cases: Migration upgrade/backfill test from 0007 with existing chats.
Retrieval across documents with per-paper quotas and mixed embedding profiles.
Citation validation across chat documents; foreign documents rejected.
Frontend: multi-select picker, paper chips, cross-paper citation reader switch, chat listed under each paper.
verification: Ticketed on 2026-10-09 at the user's request. Not started; the user is deciding whether to add it.
